name: turn-receipt
description: After each turn, it displays the turn's tokens and cost in US dollars, its subagents' share, and the session's running total. Commands: `/receipt` shows and saves the usage for this session, `/receipt-total N` sums the kept sessions over the last N days, `/receipt-month` shows a month's tally, `/receipt-clear` clears the per session turn data, but it keeps the aggregate of usage per month.

showSessionTotals.title: Show Session Totals
showSessionTotals.description: Show the session's running total after each turn: turns receipted, tokens summed and dollars.

showSubAgentDetails.title: Show Subagent Details
showSubAgentDetails.description: Add a line for the subagent details in the last turn: runs, tokens and dollars. When false | Off, their cost is folded into the turn's figure.

saveEveryNNTurns.title: Save every NN turns
saveEveryNNTurns.description: How many turns pass between saves of the session's total. 0 saves only at session end, and on /commands.

keepSessionDetailsNNDays.title: Keep detailed session records for NN days
keepSessionDetailsNNDays.description: Deletes detailed session records older than NN days. Saves space. The per calendar month tallies are separate and not affected by this setting.

allowEmptyReceipts.title: Allow empty receipts
allowEmptyReceipts.description: Print a receipt even when the turn reported no usage and moved no ledger; token counts read 0. When Off/false, empty turns do not get a receipt and are not counted.
